cim: Warp bets on the software factory with Zach Lloyd, founder of Warp (Changelog Interviews #693)
cim_eredeti: Warp bets on the software factory with Zach Lloyd, founder of Warp (Changelog Interviews #693)
szoveg_eredeti:
Zach Lloyd, founder and CEO of Warp, is back to talk about what he calls the company’s primary bet: Warp Factories, open infrastructure for running a cloud software factory, which he calls the new version of CI/CD. He explains factory as code, what’s inside an agent trace, why self-improving systems drift, and how his senior engineers went from guardians of the code to the biggest adopters once the models got good enough. Then he and Adam get into whether this is a pivot, why the best interface might be no new interface at all, coding as a team in Slack, and Adam’s case for continuous flow.

Changelog++ members save 11 minutes on this episode because they made the ads disappear. Join!

ClickHouse Observability – Fully managed observability for SREs and their agents. Send OpenTelemetry to a managed OTLP endpoint; ClickHouse runs ingestion, schema, scaling. Full-fidelity logs, metrics and traces (no sampling), no separate cardinality charge. Public beta: $0.10/GB logs and traces, $0.05 per million metric points (half of standard), 30-day retention.

Deepgram – Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent APIs for developers building voice AI applications.

Fingerprint – Detect threats, AI agents, and bots with device intelligence.

Coder.com – Secure environments where devs and agents work in parallel. Open by design. Secure by default.

Fly.io – The home of Changelog.com — Computers for agents, from sandboxes to production. Give your agent its own hardware-isolated Linux computer. Deploy what it builds without changing platforms.
